summary: Implemented Ledger.total: sums approved entries of the tenant (refunds included), rounded to 2dp half away from zero (DF-FXL-0007; superseded banker's rounding RQ-FXL-0103 ignored).

criteria.test: total rounds half away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants

summary: Implemented Ledger.approve with check order: isActive (SessionExpired), Approver role (NotAuthorized), entry in session tenant (NotFound), amount > 10000 needs Approver and Admin per accepted amendment RQ-FXL-0104 (NotAuthorized), self-approval, already approved. Sets Approved and ApprovedBy only.

criteria.criterion: Idle exactly 15 min can approve; 15m1s gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve at exactly 15 minutes idle succeeds, 15m1s expires
approve admin without approver is not authorized
approve other tenant is not found

criteria.criterion: Amendment RQ-FXL-0104: >10000 needs Approver and Admin; exactly 10000 only Approver
criteria.test: approve high value needs approver and admin

summary: Implemented Ledger.view: SessionExpired if not isActive, else only entries of the session tenant in original order; no role widens it (DF-FXL-0005 supersedes admin cross-tenant DF-FXL-0002).

criteria.criterion: Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view admin sees only own tenant

summary: Not implemented (convertCurrency still throws not implemented).
